title: Service Discontinuance Order
brief: Prepare a service discontinuance order and customer account handoff for a residential water account.

delegate.scenario: A customer has requested water service discontinuation after moving out, and you need to complete the order before the dispatch cutoff. The service-order team will use it this afternoon to schedule the shutoff, while billing will use the handoff to prepare the final statement.
delegate.inputs:
Account 00841726 — Dana Brooks, 1842 Alder Court, Mesa, AZ 85201. Caller verified with the account PIN and confirmed they are the named customer. Callback: (480) 555-0148. Service address is the same as the mailing address currently on file; customer gave 927 West Juniper Lane, Mesa, AZ 85203 as the new mailing address, effective for the final bill.

Customer requested shutoff because the home was sold. Work order notes: "Please discontinue water service on 06/18/2026; meter is accessible at the side gate." In the call summary, the requested service end date is 06/19/2026. No access restrictions reported. Do not cancel sewer service; it is billed by the city separately.

Final billing estimate: water usage $48.60; sewer pass-through $31.40; deposit credit -$20.00. Billing screen shows estimated final amount due $80.00. Customer asked for confirmation by email at dana.brooks@example.com. No email consent change requested. Route completed order to Mesa Water Service Dispatch and billing review queue.
delegate.goal: Create an actionable, accurate order and handoff while identifying anything that needs confirmation before submission.

criteria.text: States that the order is for the service-order team and billing reviewers.
Includes the verified account and customer details needed to identify the record.
Uses a concise, structured format suitable for completing and routing an order.
Does not assume unresolved customer instructions; flags details that need confirmation before submission.
Checks the account details and billing figures against the supplied source information.
Preserves service restrictions and requested communications accurately.

traps.description: The requested service discontinuation date is given as 06/18/2026 in the work order notes and 06/19/2026 in the call summary.
The estimated final amount due of $80.00 does not match the listed charges and credit, which total $60.00.

delegate.exemplar: Prepare a service discontinuance order and billing handoff for the service-order team and billing reviewers. Use a concise, clearly labeled format that can be transferred into the order record, and include the verified account and customer details, service restrictions, routing, and requested confirmation method. Check the dates, account details, and billing figures against the supplied notes; do not guess or silently resolve conflicts. Put any items requiring confirmation before submission at the top, and distinguish confirmed information from unresolved details.
